stops.name: Reisadalen
stops.detail: The Reisa National Park (Norwegian: Reisa nasjonalpark, Sami: Njállaávzi nasjonalpark) is a Norwegian national park located mainly in Reisadalen.

stops.name: Reisaelva
stops.detail: The park covers the upper part of the Reisaelva and runs along the border with Finland.

stops.name: Halti Nationalparkzentrum
stops.detail: An exhibition in the Halti National Park Center is dedicated to Kven culture.

days.title: Waterfalls and Trekking Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Mollisfossen-Wasserfall
stops.detail: In the course of the Reisaelva lies the 269-meter-high Mollisfossen waterfall, whose free-fall height is 140 meters.

stops.name: Nedrefosshytta
stops.detail: In the park, there are several unstaffed huts, such as the Nedrefosshytta, which is operated by the Norwegian Trekking Association and is located on the Nordkalottruta.

stops.name: Imofossen-Wasserfall
stops.detail: In the mountains north of the Imofossen waterfall, there are sometimes very large canyons where you can easily see the many different rock deposits.

stops.name: Ráisjávri See
stops.detail: In the east of the park, there is also a hut by Lake Ráisjávri.
